title: A recovery spell shorter than the timelock takes over before the owners can answer
rootCause: RecoverySpell.executeRecovery checks only its own delay, so with a delay shorter than the timelock, which the contract comment asks deployers to use, a malicious spell runs before the owners can remove it through a timelocked proposal.

poc.observable: test_a_spell_cannot_run_before_the_owners_can_answer_it fails with "the spell waits for the answer from the owners"
